cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our team in the Mission Critical Sector.
Please note: You must be able to travel to and from existing and new project sites for observation, investigation, evaluation purposes, attending client, project and construction meetings.
The Senior Mechanical Engineer is responsible for the design and technical systems for large, complex projects from concept development through construction administration. You will provide leadership and guidance to less tenured engineers and engineering designers. You will have guidance from the local Mechanical Engineering Discipline Leader, supporting and advising you on your approach and engineering decisions.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Direct and oversee project team members within the discipline.
Monitor staff to produce quality engineering experience for our clients as part of an integrated team concept.
Work with engineers and teams remote to home office location.
Review, digest, and respond to RFPs.
Participate in the development of the project cost model and ensure the design team meets expectations.
Create building system concepts and drive documentation process from schematics through construction administration phases.
Engage in early project charettes identifying opportunities and challenges as part of an integrated design team.
Prepare and document required code research for project.
Develop and maintain Mechanical Basis of Design Journal through the life of the project.
Prepare and monitor project status reports.
Conduct material and product research for project development.
Function as Discipline Team Leader when required.
Attend project meetings as necessary.
Interface with other Discipline Team Leaders to ensure top level coordination and design development.
Document RFI responses and submittal reviews during bidding and construction administration.
Mentor and support engineers to help prepare them for greater project responsibilities.
Provide feedback on performance of support engineers.
Identify opportunities to improve quality of services and deliverables and participate in the implementation.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Professional Engineering License, or ability to become licensed within 12 months.
Mission Critical/Data Center experience.
IES-VE Modeling experience.
Revit BIM design experience.
Extensive knowledge of all aspects of professional services from schematic design through project close-out, including design and technical expertise.
A comprehensive understanding of the coordination aspects and related requirements of all design disciplines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational skills.
Ability to motivate, mentor and effectively delegate work assignments.
Computer literate with typical Microsoft Productivity Suite.
Preferred Requirements:
Bachelor's degree.
LEED Accredited.
7+ Years' experience in A/E industry.
If this interests you, apply now!

Experience with Revit BIM design.
Background in Mission Critical/Data Center work.
Familiarity with all aspects of professional services from schematic design through project close-out, including design and technical work.

cond_0225.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our team.
Please note: You must be able to travel to and from existing and new project sites for observation, investigation, evaluation purposes, attending client, project and construction meetings.
The Senior Mechanical Engineer works alongside the team on the design and technical systems for large, complex projects from concept development through construction administration. You will support and guide less tenured engineers and engineering designers, and you will work closely with the local Mechanical Engineering Discipline Leader, who will help inform your approach and engineering decisions.
cond_0225.responsibilities:
Key Responsibilities:
Coordinate with and support project team members within the discipline.
Work alongside engineers and teams to deliver quality engineering outcomes for clients as part of an integrated team.
Collaborate with engineers and teams remote to home office location.
Review, digest, and respond to RFPs.
Contribute to the development of the project cost model and help ensure the design team meets expectations.
Develop building system concepts and support the documentation process from schematics through construction administration phases.
Participate in early project charettes to identify opportunities and challenges as part of an integrated design team.
Prepare and document required code research for project.
Develop and maintain Mechanical Basis of Design Journal through the life of the project.
Prepare and monitor project status reports.
Conduct material and product research for project development.
Serve as Discipline Team Leader when required.
Attend project meetings as necessary.
Coordinate with other Discipline Team Leaders to ensure top level coordination and design development.
Document RFI responses and submittal reviews during bidding and construction administration.
Mentor and support engineers to help prepare them for greater project responsibilities.
Provide feedback on performance of support engineers.
Identify opportunities to improve quality of services and deliverables and work with the team on implementation.
cond_0225.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Professional Engineering License, or ability to become licensed within 12 months.
IES-VE Modeling experience.
Revit BIM design experience.
Mission Critical/Data Center experience.
Extensive knowledge of all aspects of professional services from schematic design through project close-out, including design and technical expertise.
A comprehensive understanding of the coordination aspects and related requirements of all design disciplines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational skills.
Ability to motivate, mentor and effectively delegate work assignments.
Computer literate with typical Microsoft Productivity Suite.
Preferred Requirements:
Bachelor's degree.
LEED Accredited.
7+ Years' experience in A/E industry.

We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our team in the Mission Critical Sector.
Please note: You must be able to travel to and from existing and new project sites for observation, investigation, evaluation purposes, attending client, project and construction meetings.
The Senior Mechanical Engineer is responsible for the design and technical systems for large, complex projects from concept development through construction administration. You will provide leadership and guidance to less tenured engineers and engineering designers. You will have guidance from the local Mechanical Engineering Discipline Leader, supporting and advising you on your approach and engineering decisions.
cond_0631.responsibilities:
Direct and oversee project team members within the discipline.
Monitor staff to produce quality engineering experience for our clients as part of an integrated team concept.
Work with engineers and teams remote to home office location.
Review, digest, and respond to RFPs.
Participate in the development of the project cost model and ensure the design team meets expectations.
Create building system concepts and drive documentation process from schematics through construction administration phases.
Engage in early project charettes identifying opportunities and challenges as part of an integrated design team.
Prepare and document required code research for project.
Develop and maintain Mechanical Basis of Design Journal through the life of the project.
Prepare and monitor project status reports.
Conduct material and product research for project development.
Function as Discipline Team Leader when required.
Attend project meetings as necessary.
Interface with other Discipline Team Leaders to ensure top level coordination and design development.
Document RFI responses and submittal reviews during bidding and construction administration.
Mentor and support engineers to help prepare them for greater project responsibilities.
Provide feedback on performance of support engineers.
Identify opportunities to improve quality of services and deliverables and participate in the implementation.
cond_0631.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Professional Engineering License, or ability to become licensed within 12 months.
Mission Critical/Data Center experience.
IES-VE Modeling experience.
Revit BIM design experience.
Extensive knowledge of all aspects of professional services from schematic design through project close-out, including design and technical expertise.
A comprehensive understanding of the coordination aspects and related requirements of all design disciplines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational skills.
Ability to motivate, mentor and effectively delegate work assignments.
Computer literate with typical Microsoft Productivity Suite.
Preferred Requirements:
Bachelor's degree.
LEED Accredited.
7+ Years' experience in A/E industry.
If this interests you, apply now!
